title: Newhalo legal text
description: A long text page on paper: sticky white topic tiles on the left (the section in view turns orange), the text on the right with 64px section headings, 32px and 24px sub-headings, 16px body and plain bullet lists. On phones the tiles become a sideways row that sticks to the top of the window.
notes: the orange tile follows your scrolling (hydrate: visible); the tiles link to the sections either way
